# Vista Plastering Melbourne

> > Award-winning Melbourne plastering company delivering 5-star residential and commercial plastering, plasterboard installation, and building systems with 35 years of expertise.

Vista Plastering Melbourne is a full-service plastering contractor specializing in residential renovations, commercial fit-outs, and specialized building systems. They offer comprehensive services from plasterboard installation and metal stud framing to acoustic treatments and external cladding, all compliant with Australian building standards (NCC, AS/NZS).
